finding: The observer timeline stored the raw bug/file message, so secrets (the Windows user name in a file path, keys in a bug message) flowed into /api/events and timeline.json

first_detect_run.result: FAILED - the timeline stored 'factory stopped: C:/Users/<username>/Downloads/trace.log' verbatim
first_detect_run.note: An earlier draft of this test PASSED and that pass was false: record() early-returns while the observer is disarmed, so nothing was stored. The test was hardened (arm ENABLED, demand a non-empty timeline) and only then demonstrated the leak. The vacuous pass was rejected, not reported as a fix.

fix: scrub() at the record() boundary so every observer caller is redacted, not just the bugs.rs call site
